front_line: The light that moves AI's data. Photonics and lasers wiring the datacenter buildout
thesis: Lumentum makes the lasers and optical parts that move data as light inside AI data centers. The earnings curve is steepening, not flattening, and the durable edge sits in the boring laser/photonics-manufacturing business the market is ignoring. Good company, wrong price — watching for the Aug 10 margin print to confirm the moat before paying bull-case prices.
moat: Narrow — durable in lasers, weak and re-bid every cycle in the hyped transceiver line.
risks: Inverted asymmetry: -72% bear vs +24% bull at today's price.

categories.label: Portfolio Fit
categories.note: High-growth AI exposure, but at a premium

drafts.x_post: $LITE: the market is paying a compounder price for the cheap half of the moat. The AI-transceiver hype everyone loves is the most contestable; the durable edge lives in the lasers nobody talks about. Good company, inverted asymmetry. Dead Simple Score 79 — Watchlist.
video_talking_points: Lumentum makes the lasers and optical parts that move data as light between chips and servers inside AI data centers.
It's up huge on the AI-optics trade, with EPS roughly tripling across four quarters and analysts overwhelmingly bullish.
The earnings curve is steepening, not flattening — that looks like real structural demand, with a durable, ignored moat in laser manufacturing.
But you're buying perfection: +24% to the bull case versus -72% to the bear — risking three dollars to make one.
The verdict flips to Buy if gross margin expands 200+ bps on the Aug 10 call, and to Pass if margins are flat while revenue rises.
Watch: good company, wrong price today — you're paying bull-case price before the proof arrives.
